name: Novita AI Agent Sandbox

modes.label: Pay-as-you-go (prepaid balance)
modes.note: $0.0000098/vCPU-s + $0.0000032/GiB-s on allocation, per second. RAM in 512 MiB steps (0.5-8 GiB). Paused = $0 compute. Same rates in both regions (us-phx-1 v2, us-virginia-1 v1). Sessions > 1 h need long_running metadata (default timeout 5 min, cap 1 h without it; docs/guides/sandbox-long-running). Verified 2026-09-28: CPU 'Billed based on the number of vCPU cores used and usage duration', RAM on 'allocated memory capacity and usage duration'; paused: 'CPU and RAM stop being billed' (docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-pricing). Running-but-idle bills in full. 'Timeout is the maximum lifetime ... regardless of activity' (default onTimeout kill); an opt-in 'Idle timeout only fires when no client is connected for the configured duration' (docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-auto-resume.md).

modes.label: GPU Instance on-demand (H100 SXM 80GB, L40S, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RTX 6000 Ada)
modes.note: Novita GPU Instances, not the Agent Sandbox. Per-GPU hourly incl. a fixed host share (H100 SXM 22 vCPU/150 GiB; L40S and RTX 6000 Ada 22c/125 GiB; RTX 4090 16c/62 GiB; RTX 5090 16c/58 GiB), max 8 GPUs, 60 GB free root storage. Rendered novita.ai/gpus 2026-09-28: H100 SXM 3.39, L40S 0.55, RTX 4090 0.33, RTX 6000 Ada 0.77 /hr/GPU; RTX 5090 0.56 (now also on the rendered novita.ai/pricing?gpu=1 GPU tab, 2026-09-29). Live stock was 0 for 4090/5090/6000 Ada at capture; not guaranteed. Region not returned by the catalogue. max_vcpu/max_ram_gib set to the smallest (5090) host envelope. Serverless GPU worker prices unpublished; Dedicated Endpoints (H100 1.99, H200 2.99, 4090 0.61) are a different inference product, not modelled.
modes.stock_note: 2026-09-29 console: only H100 SXM in stock ('Low', 4 GPUs available via API); RTX 4090, RTX 6000 Ada, RTX 5090 and L40S shown 'Unavailable' (inventoryState none).

modes.label: GPU Instance spot (H100 SXM 80GB, RTX 4090, RTX 6000 Ada)
modes.note: Spot GPU Instances: 1 h initial protection, then 1 h reclaim notice. Rendered novita.ai/gpus 2026-09-28: H100 1.70, RTX 4090 0.17, RTX 6000 Ada 0.39 (API 0.385) /hr/GPU; L40S no spot.
modes.stock_note: 2026-09-29: spot listing API shows inventoryState none for all spot SKUs (incl. H100); console shows RTX 4090 and RTX 6000 Ada Unavailable.

plans.name: Free (no top-up)
plans.note: Default until account balance is topped up / credit line enabled; the $100 promo credit is spent under these limits. No priority scheduling.

plans.name: Paid (pay-as-you-go)
plans.note: Unlocks when balance > $0. Session cap conflicting: 24 h (landing), 3 h (docs quota table), long_running examples up to 720 h. Manual top-ups must be greater than $10 (docs payment-methods), so unlocking Paid needs a >$10 prepayment (one-time, not a monthly fee).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom contract; all limits adjustable (landing says unlimited concurrency); region selection, dedicated infra, 99.95% SLA. Pricing not published.

perf_source: StarSling hpc-sandbox-benchmarks, run 36498291449 (2026-09-29), Node.js V8 Web Tooling p50 at a 4 vCPU / 8 GB target

knobs.label: Idle time billed until the sandbox timeout fires (× session hours)
knobs.why: Default timeout is 5 min and the default onTimeout action is kill; a sandbox you do not kill or pause keeps billing CPU+RAM on allocation until the timeout fires (up to 1 h without long_running, longer with it). Default 1 = killed/paused when work ends; the 2x ceiling is a judgment call.

knobs.label: Share of session actually running (onTimeout=pause + autoResume / idle_timeout)
knobs.why: Paused sandboxes cost $0 compute (state moves to Persistent Storage: 60 GB free per account, then $0.00009/GB-h). With onTimeout=pause + autoResume or an idle_timeout (60-86,400 s), only running time bills. Default 1 = running for the whole session.

caveats: Isolation technology not documented (E2B-derived envd, memory snapshots, virtio-mem suggest a microVM; unverified).

Persistent storage (paused sandboxes + templates + snapshots) has a 60 GB free allowance per ACCOUNT (extra key snapshot_free_gib_account), then $0.00009/GB-h = $0.0657/GB-month; billed daily; landing (2026-09-29): 'Measured hourly and charged daily. First 60 GB included'. An engine ignoring the allowance overstates small snapshot bills.
Paused sandbox state includes memory; its GB size is not documented.
Max session: 1 h default cap without long_running; Paid 3 h (docs quota table) vs 24 h (landing); long_running examples 168 h / 720 h.
Default timeout 5 min and default onTimeout action is kill.
The $100 promo credit may not unlock Paid-tier limits; Paid requires a top-up or credit line. Credit validity period unspecified.
No minimum billed duration or per-start fee documented (Novita blog: 'no additional per-session startup fee').
Egress, volume (beta) and Enterprise pricing not published.
Overdue prepaid balance terminates sandboxes with data loss; no spend caps.
Ephemeral disk fixed at 20 GB (Enterprise adjustable); no per-GB disk upgrade price.
Benchmarks: only hpc CPU (13.52 Node.js tooling runs/s, n=10); no computesdk cold-start/burst/dax data.
Idle auto-stop exists but is off by default (must be configured), so the estimator does not apply idle suspension; set a pinned offer if you enable it.

GPU Instances (novita.ai/gpus) are a separate GPU-cloud product from the CPU Agent Sandbox, modelled as alt-flagged gpu_only modes (patch v4-gpu, 2026-09-28). PPIO (ppio-sandbox card, China, CNY 0.108/vCPU-h + 0.054/GiB-h) is a separately billed offer; engineering overlap with Novita is visible (novita-gym PPIO templates) but common ownership / shared credits are unverified (patch v10-regional).

GPU Instance regimes un-flagged alt (fix 2026-09-28): an ordinary self-serve GPU VM product; prices re-rendered from novita.ai/gpus 2026-09-28 (H100 SXM 3.39 / spot 1.70 /hr/GPU). Egress is still not published on docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-pricing or novita.ai/sandbox (egress_gib stays null).

GPU Instance billing: 'accurate to the second and settled hourly'; billing starts when the instance 'enters the pulling state' (image pull time is billed, boot_overhead_s unknown). Stopped GPU instances keep data up to 7 days and pay $0.005/GB/day storage; container disk has 60 GB free then $0.005/GB/day; volume disk $0.005/GB/day; network volume $0.002/GB/day. These GPU storage rates are not modelled in the card storage block (which describes the Agent Sandbox).

Agent Sandbox account quota also has aggregate limits: concurrentVcpu and concurrentRamMb (docs example for a 100-instance account: 200 vCPU / 409,600 MiB). Per-tier values are not published; if the Paid tier really is 200 vCPU, 100 concurrent sandboxes only fit at <=2 vCPU each (50 x 4 vCPU, 25 x 8 vCPU).

GPU Instance prices vary by cluster in the first-party market API (not on rendered pricing pages): RTX 4090 $0.67/h (spot 0.335) in the Dallas clusters vs $0.33 elsewhere; RTX 5090 'RTX 5090 32GB' SKU $0.69-0.73/h (spot 0.35-0.365) vs the $0.56 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090' SKU; L40S spot $0.275 appears in CN-HK-01 only. All of these were out of stock on 2026-09-29.
GPU Instance overview advertises 'free network transfer'; Agent Sandbox egress is still unpublished (network.egress_gib null).

fleet.verification: Free promotional credit requires account setup survey, no card; real balance top-up or credit line activates paid tier.
fleet.tiers: Free 5; Paid 100 after top-up; Enterprise 500 default, adjustable via support.
fleet.notes: 10/50 paid self-serve; 300 Enterprise; 1,000 requires quota request. Docs say paid max session 3h while landing page says 24h, so duration needs confirmation. Aggregate vCPU/GPU account quotas and approval delay not stated.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: On timeout or idle timeout you can choose **pause** (so the sandbox can be resumed later, optionally with auto-resume) instead of **kill**. When paused, resuming restores the sandbox to Running with its state intact
snapshot_auto.note: Opt-in per sandbox at create time (lifecycle onTimeout='pause' / autoPause with idle_timeout metadata); default is kill ('If you do not pass `lifecycle`, the sandbox is killed when the timeout expires'). Triggers: max-lifetime timeout or idle timeout (no client connected). Memory included: paused state keeps 'filesystem and memory state' incl. running processes. autoResume wakes it on SDK call / inbound HTTP.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: A snapshot is a reusable saved state of a sandbox. It captures the sandbox filesystem and memory state so you can start new sandboxes from that point later.
snapshot_on_demand.note: SDK sandbox.create_snapshot() / CLI `novita snapshot create <sandbox_id>` on a running sandbox (paused during capture); new sandboxes boot from it via novita.sandbox.create(snapshot_id) (fork/template). Memory included. v2 region (us-phx-1) only. Manual pause/resume also keeps memory. Legacy v1 commit/clone also exists.

own_agent_api.quote: The CLI's `agent invoke` command sends a payload to a deployed Novita Agent and returns its response. It supports both plain-text prompts and structured JSON input, and can stream the response as it is produced.
own_agent_api.note: Novita Agent Runtime: wrap your own agent (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI etc.) with @app.entrypoint, deploy with `novita agent launch`, invoke with prompt via CLI or AgentRuntimeClient.invoke_agent_runtime, streaming, 'Session Persistence: Multiple invocations to the same sandbox instance, supporting multi-turn'. Also NovitaClaw CLI deploys/manages a persistent OpenClaw agent (chat via Web UI/TUI). Claude Code and Codex are only preinstalled templates driven via generic commands.run (`claude -p`), which does not count. No first-party Claude Code/Codex session API.

harness_api.quote: The CLI's `agent invoke` command sends a payload to a deployed Novita Agent and returns its response. It supports both plain-text prompts and structured JSON input, and can stream the response as it is produced.
harness_api.note: Novita Agent Runtime: wrap your own agent (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI etc.) with @app.entrypoint, deploy with `novita agent launch`, invoke with prompt via CLI or AgentRuntimeClient.invoke_agent_runtime, streaming, 'Session Persistence: Multiple invocations to the same sandbox instance, supporting multi-turn'. Also NovitaClaw CLI deploys/manages a persistent OpenClaw agent (chat via Web UI/TUI). egress_allowlist.quote: Network configuration provides finer-grained control over outbound traffic by allowing you to define allowlists and denylists.
egress_allowlist.note: network.allowOut/denyOut at create (IPs/CIDRs and domains incl. '*.github.com' in SDK example, with denyOut 0.0.0.0/0 for default-deny); allow_internet_access=False / CLI --no-internet for no-internet mode; `novita sandbox network <id>` updates egress rules of a running sandbox (CLI page lists IP/CIDR destinations only).

ingress_rules.quote: (--public-traffic makes the sandbox URL accessible without an access token)
ingress_rules.note: Sandbox port URLs (getHost(port)) require an access token unless created with --public-traffic; maskRequestHost option; envd control API protected by 'secure access' token by default since SDK v2.0.0. No IP allowlists documented.

guest_firewall.note: E2B-derived microVM (memory snapshots, virtio-mem hotplug; card says firecracker, isolation not officially documented) with root/sudo; iptables/nftables not mentioned in docs.

secret_proxy.quote: The real Secret value is never delivered into the sandbox. What the sandbox holds is an opaque placeholder; the substitution to the real value happens at the proxy layer, outside the sandbox.
secret_proxy.note: Team-scoped Secrets with a per-secret `hosts` allow list (any hostname, '*.' wildcards); env var holds placeholder novita_secret_<hex>; substituted only in HTTPS request header values (not bodies, URL/query, plain HTTP or WebSocket messages); responses are filtered back to the placeholder. Non-HTTP (DB, SSH, git over SSH) not covered. v2 region only.

volume_attach.quote: A volume is a persistent storage resource that can be mounted into sandboxes to share and preserve data across sandbox lifecycles.
volume_attach.note: Beta, v2 region only; create with GiB/inode quota, mount at create (volume_mounts) or at runtime (mount_volume/unmount_volume). Pricing not published.

volume_shared.note: Read-write. Docs also say 'You can attach the same volume to different sandboxes over time'; simultaneous multi-sandbox mounts are implied (volume carries its own auth token, network-style) but not explicitly stated. S3 bucket mounts are DIY s3fs-fuse, not first-party.
